operators.name: cat_dim1_forward
semantics: Concatenates x1 and x2 along dimension 1.
Both inputs must have the same shape except on dim=1.
Output shape is [N, C1+C2, H, W] where N=512, C1=C2=10, H=W=128.

operators.name: smooth_l1_loss_mean_forward
semantics: Computes smooth_l1_loss of x against zeros with reduction='mean'.
Equivalent to mean(smooth_l1(x,0)) over all elements.
smooth_l1 formula: if |x| < 1, loss = 0.5 * x^2; else loss = |x| - 0.5.
Output is a scalar tensor on CUDA.
x1 and x2 are CUDA tensors of shape [512,10,128,128].
Result x has shape [512,20,128,128] on CUDA.
torch.zeros_like(x) creates a zero tensor of same shape as x.
smooth_l1_loss with target=0 and reduction='mean' (since self.loss_reduction='mean').
For each element: if |x_i|<1, loss_i=0.5*x_i^2 else |x_i|-0.5.
Final loss is mean of loss_i over all elements.
Output is scalar tensor on CUDA.
